findings.label: Guard/button condition asymmetry
findings.detail: The missing-OTP guard tests `!variables?.[0]` (truthiness) while the button-building block tests `vars.length > 0` (presence). The gap is unreachable because the guard already rejects auth templates lacking a truthy variables[0], so the button block never runs for an auth template with an empty/falsy OTP. Optional cleanup: align both conditions on `variables?.[0]` for local clarity. Not blocking.
